scientific_integrity: Exact rational Jacobian and equilibrium certificates for one construction; universal upper bound follows from strict concavity and a determinant-sign necessity. No numerical extrapolation to all parameters.
scientific_limitations: Local exponentially stable equilibria only; no global basin or convergence analysis, no stochastic or heterogeneous extension, historical priority bounded by full-text access.
title: Three is the sharp local-attractor capacity of a conformist behavioral SIRS model
